title: OverSire memory
description: Short, editable facts that AI jobs read. The user edits them. An entry that the AI proposes is a suggestion first.

MemoryKind.description: Missing means fact. A vision entry is the true north of a project: scope project, a scopeRef of kind project, and the id vision-<ProjectRef.storeKey>. Thus each project has one vision entry, and a second write replaces the first. Only the user writes a vision. The hub refuses a suggestion with kind vision.

MemoryDraft.description: The proposal of a suggestion. On accept, the hub writes a MemoryEntry.

scopeRef.description: The project or the subject. Missing for scope user.

suggestion.description: The Suggestion id when the source is suggestion.
